rulings.why: dyingThresholdBonus is read only from content.feats (build.ts:2655) - nothing reads it off an item, and it is a relic ASPECT that can never be worn or invested, so the fix writes dead data.
A worse MAP with the adjusted weapon is an owner-side penalty nothing carries; situational is the legal item field and the shape (strikeAttack + when + bonus) passes the applier's target-kind guard.

Uplifting Overture's benefit lands on an ALLY, the tradition 'occult' is invented (the spell has no tradition list), and innateSpells is read only from INVESTED items (build.ts:2957) while this record has no 'invested' trait and no equip control, so it could never fire.
Two separate 1/day activations but the record's single frequency synthesizes only one tracker, so the counters are a real gap; the note-only mode carries fromItemId and legal ModeDef fields.

The Crafting star stands, but grantedStrikes is collected only from INVESTED items (build.ts:1024) and all four shipped grantedStrikes sit on 'invested' records - this relic has no such trait - and 'wheel-blades' already exists as its own item, so the Strike half is dead and redundant.

situational.when: to Craft using the chair's built-in sterling artisan's tools

rulings.why: The +1d6 persistent force vs constructs is target-conditional owner damage the record's d12 maul block does not carry; a weapon is equippable so the situational star actually shows.
Spellheart with no heldSpells at all; divine-lance (0) and divine-wrath (4) exist at the stated ranks and heldSpells needs no worn/invested gate, matching flaming-star and grim-sandglass.
Same gap at the greater tier; ranks 0/6/7 match the printed text, spell ids verified, and freq+freq2 for two 1/day activations follows the hyldarfs-fang counter pattern.
Same gap at the major tier; divine-decree (7) and summon-deific-herald (8) both exist and the two 1/day counters are well formed.
The extradimensional space is already carried but the four daily tarts are a separate owner-usable healing stock with no counter; the counters entry is complete (id/label/max/per/resetsOnRest).
The aura explicitly includes the OWNER ('you or an ally'), so it is not ally-only; the die and the 'precision' type match the text and the entry is display-only.
Same owner-inclusive aura at 1d6; type and shape match the text and nothing in the record carries it.
Same owner-inclusive aura at 1d8; type and shape match the text and nothing in the record carries it.

landSpeedMin is read only from feats/classFeatures/heritages (derive.ts:1888-1890), so the applier's usedIn() guard rejects it on an item, and passiveEffects.speeds.land is ADDITIVE, which would over-grant; the honest home is the display-only speed star.

situational.bonus: your Speed becomes 20 feet, or your swim Speed if that is lower

rulings.why: Raising the kickback bonus from 1 to 2 is +1 damage the owner deals and nothing carries it; scoping it to the modified firearm as a situational star avoids the over-grant a flat strikeDamage would cause.

grantedStrikes is collected only from INVESTED items (build.ts:1024) and every shipped grantedStrikes sits on an 'invested' record; this relic aspect has no such trait and no equip control, so the Strike would never reach the Strikes page.

Printed as a steel shield with Hardness 8 / HP 64 / BT 32 but stored as 'equipment' with no shield block, so it gives no AC and Shield Block has nothing to spend; acBonus 2 matches steel-shield and the reinforced Hardness/HP/BT match the text.

The pick would never deliver a language: build.ts:3266 reads languages only from content.items[...].passiveEffects.grantsLanguages on INVESTED items, never from resolvedItemPassives, and this relic aspect has no 'invested' trait, so all 18 options resolve to nothing.

fix.note: Real grant, no lane. Item-granted languages are read at build.ts:3266 from the STATIC passiveEffects.grantsLanguages of invested items only, so an effectChoices pick can never supply one; and a relic aspect (no 'invested' trait, itemType 'equipment') can never be worn or invested. Needs the language reader to consult resolvedItemPassives before any item choice lane can grant a language.

rulings.why: Five questions per vial is finite owner-side stock and the record carries no counters and no frequency; counters is the multi-use stock lane and an absent resetsOnRest reads falsy, which is the correct behaviour for a per-vial pool.

The conjured dagger persists until redrawn, and vengeful-arm already ships exactly this pattern (an invested item granting a non-unarmed weapon Strike with striking dice baked in); the boots carry the 'invested' trait so the grant applies.
A 55,000 gp longspear stored as 'equipment' with no damage/group/category/hands cannot be wielded or Struck with at all; the supplied longspear block matches the base weapon.
Same defect as the lesser tier - a 35,000 gp shield with no acBonus/hardness/hp/brokenThreshold; the values are the ones the text prints.

A timed activated fly Speed plus a printed -2 ITEM penalty to Stealth is exactly the ModeDef speeds+modifiers lane; the bonus type matches the text, the mode id is unused, and fromItemId gates it to the item.
Chain mail stored as 'equipment' gives the wearer no AC at all; every value supplied matches core.json's chain-mail record exactly, including strength 3 (the app stores the modifier, not the score).
Same missing armour block; the Quick Spike activation is correctly left target-side and the supplied stats match core.json's chain-mail.

heldSpells and the ranks are right, but with no charge pool chargeCounterId() returns null and canCastFromItem falls back to 'castable while you hold one' - the staff would cast 9th-rank falling stars at will. staff-of-fire ships the pool counter alongside heldSpells.

Both activations resolve on the OWNER (Scrying for the activator, Illusory Disguise on the owner for 4 hours), the mirror carries the 'invested' trait so innateSpells applies, and castRank() does honour rank 3 alongside atWill.
The printed 2d6 extra piercing is unconditional and nothing carries it; on a weapon record strikeDamage is intrinsic to that Strike only (derive.ts:1498), and appliesTo 'all' is a declared value.
+1d6 slashing against humans is target-conditional owner damage nothing carries; a weapon is equippable so the star shows, and situational is the only shape that will not fire against everything.
The greater version has no frequency, so unlike the base scarf it carries nothing at all; the scarf has the 'invested' trait, illusory-disguise exists, and rank 2 is honoured by castRank().

A relic aspect with no 'invested' trait and itemType 'equipment' can never be worn, equipped or invested (equipControl returns null, isEquippable is false), so passiveEffects never applies; and no record in the corpus models telepathy as a SenseEntry.
Five questions per vial with no counters and no frequency on an itemType 'equipment' record - a bare uses field genuinely would not render, so counters is the right lane.
Removing the -4 status penalty and the blinded condition while asleep is an owner-side change nothing carries; the mirror is invested, and the conditional wording keeps it out of the computed total.
Same finite per-vial stock, same absent counters; the counter shape renders.
Same missing shield block as its siblings; deriveShield reads exactly acBonus/hardness/hp/brokenThreshold and the record has none of them.
A standing change to every unarmed Strike (silver + Ghost Touch) that runes on inventory instances cannot express; the necklace is invested, so the display-only star actually reaches the sheet.
Prepared as a staff with void-warp and grim-tendrils and the record carries neither heldSpells nor a charge pool; the fix is the exact staff-of-fire pair of fields and both spell ids exist.

The finding is correct (kind 'striking' value 4 maps through STRIKING_TIER to mythic and STRIKING_DICE gives 5 dice) but 'rune' is not a field on any record type, so the item applier - which writes only core.items fields and modes - would reject it outright.

fix.note: core.runes['mythic-striking'] is registered as kind 'property', so etching it adds no damage dice. It is a FUNDAMENTAL striking rune: the registry entry should be {slot:'weapon', kind:'striking', value:4, level:20, price:{gp:70000}} - attachments.ts STRIKING_TIER[4] already resolves to 'mythic' and derive's STRIKING_DICE.mythic gives 4 extra dice (5 total). This is a rune-registry write, not an item-record field, so it cannot go through the item applier.

rulings.why: deriveStrike's item bonus comes only from potency runes, which a consumable bomb never has; bottled-lightning-greater already ships the identical situational entry ('+2 item', 'on attack rolls with this bomb'), so the type and lane match established precedent.
Same gap at +3, same precedent; the record carries damage only and no attack bonus of any kind.
2d6 extra against dragons is target-conditional owner damage the plain 1d6 sword block cannot carry; it is a weapon, so the star reaches the sheet.
A 12,000 gp buckler stored as 'equipment' with none of the four fields deriveShield reads; acBonus 1 matches the buckler base and Hardness 14 / HP 56 / BT 28 are the printed values.
Same missing shield block; acBonus 2 matches the standard shield base and Hardness 16 / HP 64 / BT 32 are the printed values.

Persistent bleed on the owner's own slashing/piercing melee hits is a standing addition strikeDamage cannot express (it would fire for bludgeoning and cannot mark damage persistent); the contract carries the 'invested' trait so the star applies.
